_doc: Luna phonics scope & sequence (decodable grid). Drives targeted passage selection + the Sound-Packs skill tree. `focus` is the instruction handed to the passage generator. Order = teaching sequence. Draft from CCSS RF.K-4.3 — Jennifer to bless/adjust.

patterns.label: Short a (CVC)
patterns.focus: short-a CVC words like cat, map, sad, hat, bag, ran

patterns.label: Short i (CVC)
patterns.focus: short-i CVC words like sit, pig, win, dig, hit, lip

patterns.label: Short o (CVC)
patterns.focus: short-o CVC words like dog, hot, mop, top, box, log

patterns.label: Short u (CVC)
patterns.focus: short-u CVC words like sun, bug, cup, run, mud, hug

patterns.label: Short e (CVC)
patterns.focus: short-e CVC words like bed, hen, wet, red, ten, net

patterns.label: Consonant digraphs (sh, ch, th, wh)
patterns.focus: consonant digraphs sh, ch, th, wh — words like ship, chin, that, when, fish, much

patterns.label: Consonant blends (st, bl, tr, nd)
patterns.focus: initial and final consonant blends like stop, blue, tree, hand, jump, fast

patterns.label: Long vowel silent e (CVCe)
patterns.focus: CVCe / magic-e long vowels like cake, bike, home, cute, name, ride

patterns.label: Vowel teams (ai, ea, oa, ee)
patterns.focus: long-vowel teams ai, ea, oa, ee like rain, seat, boat, feet, team, road

patterns.label: R-controlled vowels (ar, or, er, ir, ur)
patterns.focus: r-controlled vowels ar, or, er, ir, ur like car, fork, her, bird, turn, star

patterns.label: Diphthongs (ou, ow, oi, oy)
patterns.focus: diphthongs ou, ow, oi, oy like out, cow, coin, boy, cloud, town

patterns.label: Inflectional endings (-s, -ed, -ing)
patterns.focus: inflectional endings -s, -ed, -ing like jumps, played, running, wishes, hopped

patterns.label: Prefixes & suffixes
patterns.focus: common prefixes and suffixes like unhappy, redo, careful, kindness, quickly, replay

patterns.label: Multisyllabic words
patterns.focus: two- and three-syllable decodable words like basket, rabbit, garden, napkin, sunset, muffin

patterns.label: Latin roots & morphology
patterns.focus: words built from common roots/affixes like transport, inspect, predict, reaction, invisible, construction
